name: Ops Planner
summary: A weekly planner for sharing out a department's tasks, duties, and events among employees — with workload tracking, vacations, and schedules you can email. All data stays on your device.
supportSummary: Help with sharing schedules and reports by email, export and import, moving to a new phone, deleting data, and reporting a bug.
